rationale: BLOCKED, leaning YES (still in force in the main). I read the held EO 10355 (17 FR 4831, May 26, 1952; the text runs across a page break and the held extract also carries EO 10354 and the register contents): sec. 1(a) delegates to the Secretary of the Interior the President's authority under the 1910 Act (43 U.S.C. 141) and otherwise to withdraw, reserve, modify or revoke withdrawals of public lands; secs. 1(b)-(d) require public land orders, concurrence of other agencies and Budget Bureau mediation; sec. 2 rules; sec. 3 redelegation; sec. 4 supersedes EO 9337. It has no sunset. History: the catalog note lists amendments by PLO 6092 (Nov. 16, 1981) and PLO 6098 (Dec. 14, 1981) and 'See: EO 12688'; the 1989 Codification shows it 'Codified at Chapter 43, p. 864' (in force in 1989). The only acting instrument held is EO 12688, which I read: it supersedes EO 10355 only 'to the extent' it delegates the 1940 Choctawhatchee transfer authority to the Secretary of Defense. That is an express partial supersession of one narrow authority, not an ending of the order, so no NO is available; I did not use the sub-record ACT passages as an ending. A YES needs a held CURRENT: predicate through 2026-10-14, which is absent, and the effect of later land statutes on the delegated authority is not shown by any held source.
